title: Clear thinking
body: This app helped me to think clear and cut a big task into mini tasks which is very helpful to start and continue.
author: Indyvlp

title: Can’t even get through intro
body: The app is full of distractions, timers and animations which slow you down and prevent achieving anything. It is also centered about promoting itself and other apps from the developer.
author: Tommmmmmmmmmm5

title: Wrongly charged
body: Even though I cancelled well before the due date / deadline - to ensure I will not be charged for something I don’t have / use, I am still wrongly charged on my creditcard! How is this still possible?
author: YK1290

title: Nice
body: Beautiful visuals and logical structure. So far, positive! I do miss that certain tasks ask more then 30 minutes (f.e. Recording a podcast) could not set that time.
author: Ernietje

title: Extremely expensive 240€/year
body: A quarterly plan 60 euro’s…..seriously!!! And why is it when i want to update my plan i get an option for the same plan for 60 a year!!! Doesn’t make sense. I cancelled, not going to pay 240 euro’s for a subscription
author: Teemara1970

title: De app voor routine
body: Door deze app leer je langzaam maar zeker een goede routine aan
author: Suusjeg

title: Paywalled
body:
Awful, you waste time on doing the test, only to come to the step where you have to pay to proceed.

Yes you can cancel subscription within your first week, but who wants to bother with all that just to check out the app.
author: Zuigmezak
